# Viborg Børn og Unge

Viborg Børn og Unge is a pediatric and adolescent gastroenterology department that achieved full compliance with a key national quality indicator for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) diagnostic evaluation. In 2024, the department reached 100% compliance with indicator 1b of the DANIBD registry, which measures complete diagnostic workup of newly diagnosed IBD patients in children and adolescents [^src1].

The significance of this achievement lies in the national context. Indicator 1b requires three diagnostic procedures—[[gastroskopi|gastroscopy]], colonoscopy, and MR scanning or capsule endoscopy—for complete IBD evaluation in pediatric patients. In 2024, only 69% of children and adolescents across Danish hospitals met this target at the national level, making Viborg Børn og Unge's 100% compliance an exceptional outlier [^src1]. The department's performance stands in contrast to the broader pattern of regional and departmental variation documented across Denmark's IBD diagnostic services.

Viborg Børn og Unge is part of the Region Midtjylland (HE Midt) health system [^src1], and its results are tracked through the DANIBD registry, a national quality register that monitors diagnostic standards for IBD patients across Danish hospitals and regions. The registry's next scheduled audit is planned for 2026, at which point indicator 1b compliance will be re-evaluated to track progress against the national target [^src1].
